Council Member Dickey moved adopt Resolution 18-2022, a proclamation recognizing the Sustainable Tourism Plan
Council Member Dickey moved to appoint Henry Sigg to the Planning Commission for a four-year term expiring July, 2026
Council Member Rubell moved to approve the City Council meeting minutes from
Council Member Gerber moved to approve the Consent Agenda
